assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a Korean ink-brush title logo on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Exact Korean title is '연의 꽃' (three Hangul syllable blocks: 연, 의, 꽃). Match this layout precisely: top row has '연의' side by side; bottom row has one larger centered '꽃'. A tall roughly rectangular black hand-brushed outer frame surrounds both rows, with one loose black horizontal divider between rows. All writing and border BLACK INK ONLY, no red seal, no extra text. Authentic Korean brush calligraphy, confident expressive strokes, visible dry brush bristles, rich black sumi ink and a few delicate feathered edges. Folk-painting game identity, quiet, elegant, natural ink on hanji but the paper itself is NOT drawn: background fully transparent. Portrait stamp-like composition roughly 3:4, centered and complete with generous transparent margins; letters must be recognizable and correctly spelled, especially 꽃 with ㄲ and final ㅊ. No mockup, no scene, no lotus drawing, no gradient, no computer-font appearance, no watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE isolated small dew droplet resting on a lotus petal, for a Korean traditional minhwa game UI. True transparent background. Exactly one round/plump clear water bead viewed directly from above, hydrophobic convex lens, delicate curved edge and one tiny ivory crescent highlight at upper left, a soft dusty-rose reflected rim at lower right. The drop is clear and its center is mostly transparent so the pink lotus painting beneath remains visible when composited. Hand-painted Korean botanical folk-painting style with very fine irregular brown-pink ink contour and subtle mineral-pigment granulation, gentle watercolor, not glossy CGI or photorealistic stock photography. A small soft contact shade confined to the bead boundary, no large cast shadow. Centered circular bead filling 65% of square image, generous transparent padding, no petal or background included, no extra droplets, no text, no icons, no checkerboard painted into the asset. Keep the object beautiful and readable when scaled to 12–45 pixels.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production-ready sprite sheet for ONE koi fish SHADOW swimming beneath a pond in a Korean minhwa game. TRUE transparent background. EXACTLY EIGHT animation frames in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, eight identically sized square cells, read left-to-right top row then bottom row. Every cell contains ONE copy of THE SAME fish at the same center, same scale, head pointing RIGHT. Each fish stays fully within its cell with at least 12% clear transparent margin. No cell borders, no grid lines, no numbers, no words. Full sheet wide 2:1. The eight poses form one seamless tail-swimming cycle: phase 0 neutral, 1 tail bends up slightly, 2 maximum up, 3 easing to neutral, 4 neutral, 5 tail bends down, 6 maximum down, 7 easing back to neutral. Head and body center remain fixed across all frames; only the tail and flowing fins undulate gently. Top-down silhouette of a graceful koi/carp with broad head, tapered body, paired pectoral fins and a gently forked tail; recognizable fish shape. SHADOW ONLY: muted translucent blue-charcoal/soft ink gray, no orange/white fish markings, no eyes or scale detail, no highlights. Handmade traditional Korean minhwa ink-wash painting, soft feathered edges, irregular brush pigment and subtle paper-grain breakup, like the soft underwater shadow of a hand-painted lotus petal. Not pixel art, not vector, not photorealism, not an actual colorful fish. Consistent size and opacity in every frame. No water or background painted in.
